name: MACS J0547.0-3904 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0547.0-3904, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj0547-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies gathers around a central galaxy whose irregular, knotted structure hints at active star formation, and whose point-like core suggests an active nucleus.

claims.text: MACS J0547.0-3904 is one of the X-ray selected massive galaxy clusters in the MACS Hubble SNAPshot surveys
MACS J0547.0-3904 is listed in the SNAPshot sample with Chandra X-ray properties
Its brightest cluster galaxy shows pronounced, irregular structure indicative of active star formation
The BCG has a point-like core in the SNAPshot images, coinciding with an X-ray point source, suggesting nuclear activity
Program 12166 is one of the Ebeling MACS SNAPshot programs
